text:
anya: ap-northeast canary stopped. deploy-bot: SBOM provenance missing for registry.redwood/model-server:1.4.3. Change window ~2.5h left. Options: pin to 1.4.2, regional carveout, or rollback to 1.4.1?

deploy-bot: GATE FAILED — sbom_provenance_missing for registry.redwood/model-server:1.4.3. Canary halted in ap-northeast. Actions: pin image, request cosign attach from build pipeline, regional carveout, or rollback.

tom: Release lead — prefer a short regional pin (1.4.2) with strict telemetry watch. Keeps global rollout alive. I can open manifest PR and coordinate QA. ETA 20m.

security-lead: Security okay with timeboxed pin IF: 1) cosign/SBOM attached within 24h, 2) mitigation ticket created (SEC-2026-0148), 3) rollback triggers defined. No permanent exception.

legal: Legal will approve a 24h carveout with security sign-off and explicit release note language. Include customer-facing line about temporary region-limited change.

qa: QA will run smoke + perf in ap-northeast once pinned. If any regression >0.6% error-rate or p99 degrade >180ms for two 5-min windows, we roll back.

ops: Ops: ensure feature-flag routing for ap-northeast and that cache shards are unaffected. If we pin, we'll run a 5% traffic slice restart before increasing.

anya: Proposed rollback criteria: (A) 5xx >0.6% sustained 10m OR (B) p99 +180ms for two consecutive 5m windows OR (C) SLO alert triggered for downstream. Owner: tom for first 12h. I'll add to PR and release notes.

tom: Commands for audit (will include in PR description):

```
# pin ap-northeast canary to previous image
kubectl -n prod-ap-northeast set image deployment/model-server model-server=registry.redwood/model-server:1.4.2 --record
# patch release manifest
git checkout -b release/pin-apne-1.4.2 && sed -i 's/1.4.3/1.4.2/' k8s/releases/canary-ap-northeast.yaml && git commit -am "pin model-server to 1.4.2 for ap-northeast carveout"
```

sec-bot: temporary-carveout-request APPROVED by @security-lead with 24h remediation SLA. Logged SEC-2026-0148. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: action=region-pin ap-northeast proceed with pinned image after PR merge. Audit entry created.

anya: Thanks — @legal please add the blurb to release notes; @tom ping when PR is up and QA starts.

legal: Added: "ap-northeast regional carveout (24h) due to SBOM provenance delay; image pinned to 1.4.2 pending cosign/SBOM verification (SEC-2026-0148)." :page_with_curl:

tom: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4601 — smoke running. Will update here. :rocket:
